definitions.explanation: A professional who prepares and examines financial records. In Japan, {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし} (CPA) is a licensed profession requiring rigorous examination.

examples.japanese: {会計士|かいけいし}に{確定申告|かくていしんこく}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I asked an accountant to handle my tax return.

examples.japanese: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}の{試験|しけん}は{難関|なんかん}だ。
examples.english: The CPA exam is very difficult.

examples.japanese: {会計士|かいけいし}{事務所|じむしょ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at an accounting firm.

notes:
COMPOUND: {会計|かいけい} (accounting) + {士|し} (professional suffix)

RELATED PROFESSIONS:
・{公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし} (CPA - Certified Public Accountant)
・{税理士|ぜいりし} (tax accountant)
・{経理|けいり} (accounting staff - not a licensed title)

DISTINCTION:
・{公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし} performs audits and is qualified to certify financial statements
・{税理士|ぜいりし} specializes in tax matters and tax filing

NOTE: The {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし} exam is considered one of the most difficult professional exams in Japan.
